name: Computer Use
author: ssh.codes
description: Codex-compatible control of Mac apps and websites through the native Cos harness, with complete app state, semantic actions, focused typing, and no redundant confirmations.

capabilities.description: Read fresh macOS accessibility trees and operate visible apps after an explicit user request.
Click, multi-click, drag, type, select text, press keys, scroll, and invoke exposed accessibility actions within the user-authorized task scope.
